parameters.queryString: ={{ "'" + $env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_INPUT_FOLDER_ID + "' in parents and mimeType = 'application/pdf' and trashed = false" }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO automacao_miller.document_processing (source_document_id, source_sha256, source_filename, status, current_stage, attempt_count, started_at, execution_id, markdown_file_id) VALUES ({{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate Markdown').item.json.source_document_id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }}, {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate Markdown').item.json.metadata.source_sha256).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }}, {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate Markdown').item.json.source_filename).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }}, 'em_processamento', 'markdown_persistido', 1, NOW(), {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($execution.id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }}, {{ $json.id ? String.fromCharCode(39) + String($json.id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) : 'NULL' }}) ON CONFLICT (source_document_id, source_sha256) DO UPDATE SET status = 'em_processamento', current_stage = 'markdown_persistido', attempt_count = automacao_miller.document_processing.attempt_count + 1, updated_at = NOW(), markdown_file_id = EXCLUDED.markdown_file_id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OLLAMA_MODEL, stream: false, format: 'json', options: { temperature: 0 }, prompt: 'Voce e um extrator documental. Use somente o Markdown abaixo. Nao use conhecimento externo e nao invente campos. Retorne JSON valido com documento, medicamentos_deferidos, medicamentos_indeferidos, suplementos_deferidos, suplementos_indeferidos, estudos_clinicos_deferidos, estudos_clinicos_indeferidos, outros_atos, exigencias, pendencias, categorias_nao_localizadas, evidencias_insuficientes, contradicoes, avisos, controle_confianca e revisao_humana. Cada item localizado deve apontar para paginas_origem. Preserve cancelado fora de indeferido. Para dispositivo, use tipo_produto_relacionado=dispositivo. Contradicoes devem ser preservadas e exigir revisao.' + String.fromCharCode(10) + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'MARKDOWN:' + String.fromCharCode(10) + $('Prepare AI context').item.json.analysis_markdown }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { metadata: { source_filename: $json.source_filename, source_sha256: $json.metadata.source_sha256, page_count: $json.metadata.page_count, converter_version: $json.metadata.converter_version }, analysis: $json.analysis } }];

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Relatorio regulatorio - ' + $('Validate and classify analysis').item.json.source_filename }}
parameters.message: ={{ 'Relatorio de apoio documental gerado. Documento: ' + $('Validate and classify analysis').item.json.source_filename + '. Revise o PDF antes de tomar qualquer decisao regulatoria.' }}

parameters.query: UPDATE automacao_miller.document_processing SET status = 'concluido', current_stage = 'email_enviado', completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), report_file_id = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Google Drive - Upload Report').item.json.id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} WHERE source_document_id = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate and classify analysis').item.json.source_document_id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} AND source_sha256 = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate and classify analysis').item.json.metadata.source_sha256).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }};

UPDATE automacao_miller.document_processing SET status = 'aguardando_revisao', current_stage = 'revisao_humana', updated_at = NOW(), error_category = 'validacao', report_file_id = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Google Drive - Upload Report').item.json.id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} WHERE source_document_id = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate and classify analysis').item.json.source_document_id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} AND source_sha256 = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate and classify analysis').item.json.metadata.source_sha256).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }};

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM automacao_miller.document_processing WHERE source_document_id = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate Markdown').item.json.source_document_id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} AND source_sha256 = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Validate Markdown').item.json.metadata.source_sha256).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} AND status = 'concluido') AS already_processed;
